newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV approves Vilesa buyout.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV approves Vilesa buyout.

text.p: Spain's stock market commission the CNMV said on Monday it had approved the buyout of Vidriera Leonesa (Vilesa) by Vista Desarrollo and Royal Bank Investments Ltd.

"The CNMV chairman has authorised the offer initiated by Vista Desarrollo and Royal Bank Investments, for 100 percent of Vidriera Leonesa's capital, that is 1,492,386 shares of 510 pesetas nominal value," the commission said in a statement.
The two buyers have offered 2,520 pesetas a share for Vilesa and the acceptance period will run for a month from when the conditions are announced.
The CNMV said the offer was conditional on the acquisition of a minimum of 746,194 shares which is equivalent to just over a half of Vilesa's shares.

"This figure will foreseeably be surpassed, due to the deal reached with two of the main shareholders who have agreed to sell their respective shares which together amount to 51.04 percent of Vilesa's capital," the CNMV said.
Banco Central Hispano and Vicasa have agreed to sell their respective 36 percent and 15 percent stakes.
The two buyers intend to reinforce Vilesa's equity capital with a one billion peseta capital expansion which will be proposed to shareholders, the CNMV said.
